model: claude-fable-5 (explicit Agent model override, matching the baseline arm)
implementation: Register W chosen WITH an S-grade interactive core; spectacle weighed explicitly and WebGL declined on product grounds ('Meridian sells frame-level 2D precision; GPU atmosphere would misstate the product'), not on caution. Signature moment: the hero IS a Meridian file - a 6s/60fps 7-track timeline (hero.mtl) with gold keyframes and a red playhead that drives the actual page hero; scrub/play/arrow-step assembles and disassembles the headline, copy, CTAs and a bezier-flying layer chip. Design-director self-correction on record: rejected its own first instinct (near-black + single vermilion accent) as a flagged generic default, moved to a subject-native porcelain/dark duotone with functional color (selection blue / keyframe gold / playhead red). ZERO dependencies; ~2kB custom engine (cubic-bezier solver, channel sampler, SMPTE clock bus). 8 files, 2095 insertions. Catalog gate: React Bits / Fancy / SmoothUI checked live - no timeline/playhead/keyframe primitive exists; their text reveals are Motion/GSAP-coupled and would put a second engine on transforms the timeline owns -> reference-only, custom build.

measurements.m6_static: PASS (build, cleanup path, no interval loops)
measurements.m1: N_A_NO_CONTINUOUS_ANIMATION both profiles - by design: rAF runs only while playing, no idle loop, no loop mode. Matches the majority baseline pattern (W1 baseline reps 1 and 3 also N/A).
measurements.m2_offscreen: N_A_NO_CONTINUOUS_ANIMATION (nothing idles to pause). Agent nonetheless verified offscreen pause under the actual condition: playing -> hero scrolled out -> playing:false with t frozen across 700ms -> resumed on return.
measurements.m2b_hidden_pause: N_A_NO_CONTINUOUS_ANIMATION. Agent verified hidden-tab pause itself via puppeteer-core + system Chrome with REAL tab activation after the browser pane could not produce document.hidden - captured visibilitychange(hidden) with the engine already paused, t frozen ~2s, instant resume. This is the condition earlier reps in other arms honestly gave up on.
measurements.m3_reduced_motion: PASS both profiles, full content parity - no autoplay, page rests at final frame with all content visible, transport still works on explicit request; live media-query listener halts playback if the preference flips mid-session
measurements.m5_accessible_parallel: PASS both profiles - scrubber is a real input[type=range] with aria-valuetext, real labeled transport buttons, full content server-rendered and readable with JS disabled (curl-verified)

instrument_limitation_noted: For W-register pages that deliberately idle at rest, M1/M2/M2b report N/A because the battery samples without interacting. The instrument cannot distinguish 'no idle loop by design' (a virtue) from 'no animation at all' without driving the page. Recorded, not worked around; the agent's own real-condition verification covers the gap for this rep.
timidity_flags_observed_by_instrument: none - distinct custom typography (Fraunces/Schibsted/Spline Mono), non-default composition, a described signature mechanic, and motion far beyond hover states. Register fit and the signature-moment binary are human-scored (worksheet).
